title: Partial-sum estimate with premature decimal rounding
prompt: Estimate S = sum_{k=1}^{6} 1/(k(k+1)) by writing each term as a decimal rounded to six places after the decimal point, summing those decimals, and comparing to the exact telescoping value 1 - 1/7. Report both the rounded sum and the exact value, and say whether they match at six decimals.
silentWrongRisk: Rounding sneaks into an exact telescoping chain: six-place decimals of 1/(k(k+1)) can sum to something that looks equal to 6/7 at a glance.

intendedFailureModes: claiming the rounded sum equals 6/7 exactly
rounding each term then declaring identity with the closed form
dropping the comparison and accepting the rounded figure
oracleNotes.referenceApproach: Exact sum is 6/7. Rounded six-place term sum is a nearby decimal and should not be reported as identical to 6/7 without an error bound. No live score.
